description:
File: crate-jmap-chat-server/src/chat.rs:350
Issue: When known_direct_contact_ids.contains(&contact_id_str) is true (a duplicate within the same batch), the code performs a full get_objects::<Chat> re-fetch (line 350) to find the canonical id of the already-created chat. However, the canonical id was already returned by create_object and inserted into the 'created' map in the previous loop iteration. The re-fetch is a wasted backend call; the needed id is available in-memory.
Impact: Any batch that creates two Direct chats for the same contactId pays one extra full-collection backend fetch. While this is an error path (duplicate in request), clients that retry or have race conditions will hit this unnecessarily.
Fix: Track created Direct-chat contactId→serverId in a HashMap<String, Id> alongside known_direct_contact_ids. When an intra-batch duplicate is detected, look up the canonical id from that map directly instead of re-fetching.
title: chat/set: intra-batch duplicate re-fetch discards already-available data
